result.description: A fictional desktop interface hub designed for color-critical studios and conference rooms, combining multi-input switching, USB-C docking, and display routing in a single compact enclosure. Meridian supports dual 4K outputs, a dedicated KVM toggle, and low-latency pass-through for presentation workstations. It is positioned as a connectivity accessory rather than storage hardware, and is intended for environments that need screen orchestration, not disk expansion.
result.title: NoriVolt Meridian Display Interface Hub
result.title_description: USB-C display interface hub with dual 4K switching and KVM support
